source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if base not in row]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != base for r in range(h))]
    nodes = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines]
    line_bg = Counter(nodes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color != line_bg and all(v == color for v in corners) else base)
        out.append(row)
    while out and all(v == base for v in out[0]):
        out.pop(0)
    while out and all(v == base for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    if out:
        while all(row[0] == base for row in out):
            for row in out:
                row.pop(0)
        while all(row[-1] == base for row in out):
            for row in out:
                row.pop()
    return out
'''

import re, importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def parse_demo(text, n):
    pat=rf'Demo pair {n} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance)'
    m=re.search(pat,text,re.S)
    print('match',n,bool(m))
    if not m:return None
    ih,iw,ib,oh,ow,ob=m.groups()
    inp=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in ib.strip().splitlines()]
    out=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in ob.strip().splitlines()]
    return inp,out
